description: EXPLORATORY (bean t7qv): asks, formally and with no physical input, whether the positive-sector LP's selected operator x* relates to the knot-convolution binding operator K. K is made exactly computable in the H_3-local model as K = M_P^-1 . atom (M_P = left multiplication by the nucleon product P, electrons excluded), and validates itself at A=2 by returning the single colour-weighted pn letter sigma_0 + D_PN.1. K(2H)'s ONLY negative NF coefficient is the gamma one and it IS D_PN, so positivity of K reduces to the sign of D_PN, which is settled in closed form: the numerator factors as (q-1)(q+1)(q^6-2q^5-5q^4-q^2+2q-1), the sextic has exactly one real root above 1 at q_c = 3.4580993000327971920, and D_PN < 0 precisely on 1 < q < q_c — which contains q_0 = 1.10998 by a factor of ~3.12. (An earlier draft claimed 'all q > 1'; false, corrected.) At A >= 3 K has 3-4 negative components at q_0. So the LP, whose feasible set is {x >= 0}, CANNOT return K; and x* is not even proportional to K on their shared support (ratios -9.640158 vs 0.290774 at A=2). STRUCTURAL READING: K and x* are complementary, not competing — K is the free-to-bound map and necessarily carries inverse-crossing (entanglement) content, x* is defined by excluding it. No fit; no B_AME; nothing wired.
caveats: CORRECTION carried in this witness: D_PN(q) is NOT negative for all q > 1. The sextic factor has a real root at q_c = 3.4580993000327971920 and D_PN > 0 beyond it. The exact statement is the interval 1 < q < q_c, which contains q_0 and the whole range swept in positive_sector_q_stability_probe.

INTERPRETATION, NOT DERIVED: the entire negative content of K(2H) is D_PN, the p-n interface offset, and the deuteron is the p-n bound system. Nothing here derives that correspondence and no physical quantity enters the computation. Recorded only so a later reader finds it labelled rather than rediscovering it as a lead.

K is computed in the H_3-LOCAL model of pyhecke.atom, where inter-nucleon crossings act on generator 0 of the same H_3. That is a different model from the (H_3)^(x)A tensor space the earlier probes' LP runs on; the A=2 comparison is made in the H_3-local model on both sides so it is like-for-like. Electrons are excluded throughout as the EM channel.
